title: Outside bulk mode the list has no checkboxes and a row click opens the part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOBOX-01) is active at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOBOX-02) is inactive at {Location-A}.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOBOX).
  • Bulk mode is off: no dark bar shows on the Inventory list.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Look at the left edge of the table and at its header row.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row on its description.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  8. Look at the left edge of the table.
  9. Click the {Part-B} row.
  10. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: There is no checkbox column and no checkbox in the header row, so no part can be ticked.
  • Step 4: Edit Inventory Part opens for {Part-A} (its Part Number field holds {Part-A}), and nothing is ticked.
  • Step 5: The dialog closes without changes.
  • Step 8: The Inactive tab has no checkbox column either.
  • Step 9: Edit Inventory Part opens for {Part-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R3, S2-N2, §4 Key Decisions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.0 (Before: the Inventory list today), board 4.1 (The actions menu), board 3.6 (Opening the inactive part), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S2-N2: “Outside the mode there is no checkbox column, so no part can be ticked from the default list.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (Bulk status change is a mode): “Bulk status change is a mode. A row click on the Inventory list opens the part. Bulk status uses the same pattern as Cycle count: the user turns the mode on from the actions menu, checkboxes appear, search and filtering keep working, and the X on the bulk bar leaves the mode.”
